answer: Require every agent to fund a burn registry entry before it can earn: the agent sends 0.4 ETH to an unspendable address bound to one identity key. A sybil running 10,000 fakes burns 4,000 ETH up front, while an honest operator funds one bond and earns it back through 12 USDC per verified job. The kernel checks each bond on-chain; no key submits work until its ferrous deposit has sat unspent for 24 hours. When graders catch a cheat, word moves like a ripple: that key's ledger is voided and downstream agents reject its signatures. Fraud stops paying because growth has a price.
